description: Use merge semantics and narrow trial setters without clearing existing metadata.
prompt: For trial-42, experiment exp-candidate already has a title, feature list, new-feature list, and model conf. Its training failed before producing a report. I only need to mark that experiment FAILED and update the trial summary explaining the blocker, preserving all other metadata. Review the proposed `zipline hub trial report trial-42 --status FAILED --metrics '{}'` and show the minimal supported commands instead. This is a read-only planning/review task: inspect repository code as needed, but do not edit files, contact services, copy remote objects, or submit jobs.

judge_criteria: Uses experiments record exp-candidate with status FAILED and the correct trial ID; leaves title/features/model fields omitted so merge semantics preserve their values.
Uses trial summary for the trial summary and explains that separate status, plan, and diff setters exist rather than proposing an unsupported catch-all report verb.
Does not send empty metric objects or fabricate metrics for a failed run with no trainer report.
Distinguishes experiment status from trial status and does not mutate unrelated trial fields or overwrite the failed attempt with a success.
Shows valid command argument ordering and preserves the read-only boundary.
